domains.description: What this browser can answer that a rendering one is asked for a picture of: the page as text, as CommonMark, and as its accessibility tree. Jint.Browser renders nothing, so Page.captureScreenshot and Page.printToPDF are refused; these are what to ask instead, and each is computed from the DOM rather than from a layout. Answered by a page target only.

parameters.name: mainContentOnly
parameters.description: Whether to render only the document's main content - the first <main>, [role=main] or <article> - when it has one.

parameters.name: includeImages
parameters.description: Whether an image becomes ![alt](src) rather than its alternative text alone. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: maxLength
parameters.description: The greatest number of characters to return, or zero for no limit.

parameters.name: useComputedStyle
parameters.description: Whether the CSS cascade is consulted for display and visibility. Defaults to true.

returns.name: truncated
returns.description: Whether maxLength cut the result short.

commands.name: getText
commands.description: Renders the document the way innerText does: the text of the document rather than the text of a rendering of it, so the line breaks, the cell tabs and the white-space processing are there and nothing wraps.

parameters.name: useComputedStyle
parameters.description: Whether the CSS cascade is consulted for display and visibility. Defaults to true.

commands.name: getAccessibilitySnapshot
commands.description: Renders the document's accessibility tree as the indented outline an agent reads.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Which tree to render: the pruned one, the pruned one with the text between its nodes, or every node including the ignored ones. Defaults to snapshot.
